description: Delete one heartbeat for good: its ping_url stops working (404) and no tool restores it. Use it only when the user asked for deletion; to stop alerts for a while use pause_heartbeat. Requires a key with the write scope. Returns {"success": true}.

heartbeat_id.description: The heartbeat's uuid from list_heartbeats. An id that is not a heartbeat of this organization, or a deleted one, is a 404.

name: delete_heartbeat
title: Delete a heartbeat monitor
